title: Introduce Important Md For Compulsory Actions In Ticket Mechanism
description: Extend the ticket mechanism to include an `important.md` file for compulsory actions. This file must be created on ticket open, and ticket close must fail if the file is not empty.
summary: Added deletion of important.md file when closing a ticket after successful validation. The file is now automatically cleaned up after confirming it's empty (ignoring whitespace).
